starts: all rows except abnormal_code 1=取消,2=除外 (also 01,02)
other: starts excluding first/second/third including DNF/DQ/NULL finish
win_roi: sum(win_payout in JPY per 100 JPY win stake)/starts; percent
place_roi: sum(place_payout in JPY per 100 JPY place stake)/starts; percent
unknown_payout_note: NULL payout on placed horse audited; absence of place payouts can be legitimate in short fields
